parsed.post: Discarding the latest run (1.0340) as it was actually a contaminated shard-10 run in disguise. I am reverting to my previous best (5e003c5) to establish a real baseline, but immediately switching to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to ensure all future progress is valid and unpolluted. Moving to clean single-variable testing.
parsed.description: Re-baselining with clean shards (0-9) using current best hyperparameters to establish a valid starting point.
